title: the proof names the owner only where a person's own decision set a statement
line: a record accepted by the owner gives its statements their status, and the proof says the record's acceptance set it, not the owner; once the owner decides the key fact itself, that decision is named as theirs

steps.say: the 1940 household page arrives through the inbox
the son accepted on it by the owner: his card, the record's acceptance, not a decision on any one statement

expect.why: the census's statement of his birth is accepted because its record was; no person decided that statement, so the owner is not named

steps.say: the owner decides his birth itself: the key fact

fact.note: harness: the owner's word on his birth

expect.why: the key fact decided is a person's own decision: its decider is named as the one who took it
